nonCookieState.name: cart-and-ui-state
nonCookieState.mechanism: React client state or explicitly reviewed local browser storage
nonCookieState.purpose: Keep non-sensitive storefront continuity client-side without creating a first-party identity cookie.

externalCookieProviders.purpose: Hosted payment and fraud-prevention flow after the customer leaves the storefront origin.

prohibited: customer, order, vendor, sourcing, margin, payment, or webhook data in cookies
tracking or advertising cookies without a separately approved consent system
forwarding Set-Cookie headers from the static asset binding
